finalText:
**Build passes now.** Two real bugs, both from the bump.

| File | Bug | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| [options.js:6](src/core/options.js:6) | Reads `options.retries`, bundler now sends `retryCount` | Accept both keys |
| [retryPolicy.js:7](src/net/retryPolicy.js:7) | Threw on `undefined` flag from the new loader | Treat `undefined` as `false` |

The 8 warnings left are the deprecation notices. They are noise from the new versions, not build breaks. Worth clearing `crypto.createCipher` in `src/legacy/adapter.js` before v5.
